title: The print is pretty on this shower curtain. Very thin
text:
The print is pretty on this shower curtain. Very thin. This shower curtain is pretty, but i's very thin. It says I need a liner, which I always use, but this is very sheer.

It's a pretty curtain. Mine did not come with hooks as posted in the description.
